PALLAVI SRIVASTAVA

A versatile professional having 16+ years of profound experience in Program & Portfolio Management, PMO Leadership, Agile Delivery, Stakeholder & Executive Engagement, Regulatory & Compliance Programs, Change Management, Business Transformation, Client Relationship Management, Risk & Issue Management, Strategic Planning in an organization of high repute.

realpals19@gmail.com 8971228197

PROFILE SUMMARY

Expertly directed enterprise-wide program and portfolio management initiatives at Standard Chartered Bank, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives, regulatory frameworks, and business transformation goals.

Efficiently established and matured Project Management Office (PMO) governance, driving program controls, delivery frameworks, and executive reporting structures across critical banking operations.

Proactively advanced large-scale Agile transformation programs, embedding Scrum and scaled Agile practices to accelerate delivery timelines and enhance cross-functional collaboration.

Skillfully managed senior-level stakeholder engagement, building trusted partnerships with C-suite executives, regulators, and global business leaders to secure alignment on strategic initiatives.

Diligently executed high-visibility regulatory and compliance programs, mitigating risks, strengthening audit readiness, and ensuring adherence to industry standards.

Seamlessly orchestrated complex change management and business transformation efforts, delivering measurable process efficiencies and driving cultural adoption across multi-country teams.

Successfully strengthened client relationship management frameworks, integrating logistics, finance, and delivery teams to create structured client engagement models and enhance customer satisfaction.

Strategically mitigated program-level risks and issues, deploying robust governance, dependency mapping, and escalation frameworks to safeguard mission-critical deliverables.

Consistently delivered robust strategic planning and execution, taking initiatives from ideation to launch while maximizing business value and operational efficiency.

Actively championed diversity and inclusion initiatives, designing and executing gender diversity programs that fostered engagement, collaboration, and organizational growth.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Aug’20 – March’26 : Standard Chartered Bank (Bangalore, Karnataka, India) as a Business Manager-PMO

Directed enterprise-wide PMO governance, aligning project portfolios with business objectives while enforcing compliance, audit readiness, and regulatory standards in banking programs.

Streamlined integrated project planning, consolidating multi-workstream roadmaps, managing interdependencies, and driving successful delivery across complex portfolios.

Optimized financial management and resource allocation, consistently delivering programs on time, within budget, and in line with strategic priorities.

Strengthened risk, issue, and dependency (RAID) management, deploying mitigation strategies to safeguard mission-critical programs against operational and reputational threats.

Elevated operational and business excellence, introducing benchmarking practices and standardized methodologies to enhance delivery efficiency and program outcomes.

Orchestrated stakeholder and client engagement, serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership while improving collaboration and visibility through effective reporting and communication frameworks.

Enhanced PMO operations with structured governance, stage-gate approvals, and oversight mechanisms, ensuring seamless execution of transformation programs within banking environments.

Mar’17 – Jul’20: Pearson & Hilti (Through Globallogic, Noida India) as a Program Manager-PMO

Directed enterprise-wide PMO operations, embedding standardized frameworks, tools, and training to strengthen project governance, quality assurance, and delivery excellence in banking.

Championed cross-functional collaboration, aligning IT, compliance, and operations teams to drive digital transformation, system upgrades, and enterprise-wide strategic initiatives.

Enforced regulatory compliance and governance controls, instituting stage-gate approvals, audit readiness measures, and risk frameworks to mitigate financial and operational exposure.

Partnered with senior leadership and executive sponsors, ensuring portfolio funding priorities, stakeholder alignment, and transparent reporting for high-visibility programs.

Designed and executed integrated program planning, overseeing resource allocation, financial management, and milestone tracking to deliver large-scale initiatives on time and within budget.

Mar’15 – Oct’16: Staples Inc. (Through Insight Global, Boston, MA, USA) as a Project Manager-Engineering

Directed end-to-end project lifecycle management, defining scope, requirements, deliverables, and governance frameworks to ensure portfolio alignment with business objectives.

Strengthened technology delivery excellence, overseeing EMC Documentum and xPlore search implementations while driving configuration management, estimation, and integration activities.

Enhanced software quality assurance, instituting 100%-unit testing, code reviews, and test case development to improve efficiency, reduce rework, and increase code coverage.

Led cross-functional collaboration and conflict resolution, fostering teamwork across onshore and offshore Java teams to deliver high-quality outcomes within strict timelines.

Delivered actionable project reporting and analytics, producing ad hoc reports, project dashboards, and executive summaries to support informed decision-making and stakeholder visibility.

PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE

Aug’14 – Nov’14: Sydney Trains (Through HCL Technologies, Australia) as a Subject Matter Expert – Documentum • Nov’11 – Jul’14: GE Appliances and Lights (Through HCL Technologies, Noida, India) as a Documentum Developer • Oct’08 – Oct’11: CITIBANK (Through HCL Technologies, Noida, India) as a FAST ESP Administrator

ACHIEVEMENTS & INITIATIVES

Honored with Partner in Excellence Award for significant contribution to Pearson project (2018). • Received Recognition & Reward Award from HCL Technologies for leading Gender Diversity initiatives. • Earned Spot Award at GlobalLogic within 3 months of joining for exceptional performance. • Commended with 50+ appreciations from C-level executives within 6 months of assignment. • Organized large-scale Gender Diversity Events at HCL, coordinating logistics, marketing, and finance functions. • Created and implemented a Client Relationship Framework to enhance client engagement and cross-team collaboration.

PERSONAL DETAILS

Languages Known: English and Hindi

Address: Bangalore, Karnataka

LinkedIn Id: Pallavi-Program-Leadership
